title: KV-LTM: Persistent Per-Session KV Caches as Long-Term Memory for Personal Assistants
abstract: arXiv:2611.21998v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Personal assistants accumulate months of conversations, but today's long-term memory stacks put derivation or selection between a question and its evidence. In a system-level comparison on LongMemEval, two commercial assistants scored well below the same model reading the history offline [1], consistent with, but not isolating, content loss between write and read. We propose KV-LTM: a memory tier storing each session's raw text plus its KV cache under a fixed reader model, answering by restoring cached sessions and appending the question. KV-LTM is complementary to, not a replacement for, retrieval and indexing. Text is the memory of record; the cache is a recompute-free prefill accelerator, degrading gracefully to text. We specify the design: storage record, budget-derived retention, append-only read path, and bounded aggregation. translated_title: KV-LTM：将会话级KV缓存作为个人助理的持久长期记忆
translated_abstract: 个人助理会积累长达数月的对话记录，但当今的长期记忆系统在问题和其证据之间设置了推导或选择环节。在LongMemEval基准上的系统级比较中，两个商业助理的得分远低于同一模型离线阅读历史记录的表现[1]，这与写入和读取之间的内容丢失相一致，但并未将其隔离出来。我们提出KV-LTM：一个记忆层，在固定的读取模型下存储每个会话的原始文本及其KV缓存，通过恢复缓存的会话并追加问题来回答查询。KV-LTM是对检索和索引的补充，而非替代。文本是记忆的正式记录；缓存则是一种无需重新计算的prefill加速器，并能优雅地降级回纯文本模式。我们明确了其设计：存储记录、基于预算的保留策略、仅追加的读取路径，以及有界聚合。我们对其进行了分析性评估：在固定的BF16全注意力（GQA）和潜缓存MLA配置下，每个（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: KV-LTM提出将每个会话的原始文本与KV缓存一同作为长期记忆存储，通过直接恢复缓存会话来回答问题，避免了传统记忆系统中问题与证据之间的推导和选择环节，并作为检索与索引的补充，充当免重算的prefill加速器。
en_tdlr: KV-LTM proposes storing per-session raw text alongside its KV cache as long-term memory for personal assistants, answering questions by directly restoring cached sessions to eliminate the derivation and selection gap between questions and evidence, complementing retrieval and indexing as a recompute-free prefill accelerator.
